lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso from the posterior haunch to the anterior shoulder. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly as they approach the hindquarters.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One visible Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the third vertical line from the posterior edge, splitting in the upper quadrant of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The final three lines near the shoulder region are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-ventral line of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of approximately 3-5 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch, situated between the posterior-most vertical line and the tail base.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal bands are visible on the lower forelimbs and hindlimbs just above the hooves; high-contrast white patch at the posterior-most point below the tail.
